title: cyperus limiticola
intro: Cyperus limiticola, commonly known as the mudflat sedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus limiticola include wound healing, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and the specific effects of these bioactive constituents.
